# Stickyy 1.2.9
## Floating note interaction
- The floating note now receives clicks and scrolling after switching from another app. - Typing and scrolling no longer affect the window behind Stickyy.
## Clean paste
- Text pasted from websites and documents is inserted as plain text and adopts the note's current style. - Paste as Plain Text is available from the editor context menu and with Command–Option–Shift–V. - Image and file attachment pasting continues to work as before.
## Updating
- Existing Stickyy users can install this release from **Check for Updates**. - The direct-download DMG remains a free Apple Development-signed test build and is not Apple-notarized. First-time users may need to approve Stickyy in **System Settings → Privacy & Security** after attempting to open it.
